summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Ethiopia's strategic importance to Red Sea security is growing amid shifting geopolitical dynamics and intensifying military competition in the Horn of Africa, Founder and CEO of the newly established Nile and Red Sea Strategic Forum, Solomon Tefera said.

title: Ethiopia Strengthening Peace in Tigray Region Through Former Combatants' Reintegration
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Ethiopia is stepping up efforts to consolidate peace in Tigray Regional State by supporting the rehabilitation and reintegration of former combatants, with skills development and economic self-reliance emerging as key pillars of the post-conflict recovery process.

title: Ethiopia Promotes Aviation Achievements, Pursues Stronger Global Representation
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Ethiopia is showcasing its growing aviation capabilities and industry achievements at the 7th Worldwide Air Transport Conference, which opened today at the headquarters of the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) in Montreal, Canada.

title: Ethiopia Strengthens Whole-of-Government Preparations to Host COP32
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed said he convened the COP32 National Steering Committee to review progress, assess preparations and provide strategic direction for Ethiopia's hosting of the global climate summit in 2027.

summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- The Federal High Court has declined the Ethiopian Media Authority's preliminary objections challenging its jurisdiction to hear a lawsuit filed by JAKENN Publishing PLC over the revocation of Addis Standard's online media registration certificate, clearing the way for the substantive case to proceed.

title: Ugandan Traditional Leaders Champion Local Talent At All Africa Leather Fair in Addis Ababa
summary: [Independent (Kampala)] Addis -- A delegation of Ugandan traditional leaders has called for stronger collaboration between cultural institutions and diplomats to promote Uganda's heritage and drive continental growth, during a courtesy visit to the Embassy of the Republic of Uganda in Addis Ababa.

title: Tigrayan Youths Face Mounting Execution Fears in Saudi Arabia - Caretaker Admin Pleads With Fed. Govt to Intervene
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Hundreds of Ethiopian migrants, many of them young people from Tigray who fled conflict and economic hardship in search of work, remain at risk of execution in Saudi Arabia, as mounting executions over drug-related offences intensify concerns about fair-trial violations and the Ethiopian government's response.

summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Dr. Negede Gobeze, a veteran Ethiopian political figure, legal scholar and co-founder of the All-Ethiopia Socialist Movement (Me'isone), died in Brussels on November 13, 2026, at the age of 83.

title: Govt Warns Nigerians With Underlying Health Conditions Against Travelling to Addis Ababa
summary: [This Day] Abuja -- The federal government has advised Nigerians with pre-existing medical conditions to seek medical advice before travelling through Addis Ababa, the Ethiopian capital, due to the potential health risks associated with the city's high altitude.

summary: [African Arguments] In a residential neighbourhood of Bahir Dar, in northwestern Ethiopia, patients visit the home of W/ro Birqe Yibre for help with injuries. Birqe, a traditional bone-setter known locally as a Wogesha, has practised for more than 20 years.

title: Ethiopia's Green Legacy Showcases Commitment to Global Climate Action - Pmo Press Secretary
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- The Green Legacy Initiative stands as a testament to Ethiopia's commitment to combating climate change through large-scale afforestation, environmental conservation and sustainable development, Press Secretary for Office of the Prime Minister (PMO) Billene Seyoum said.

summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Residents of Mekelle have urged the Federal Government to sustain and accelerate reform, reconstruction and development efforts in Tigray region.

summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Ethiopia and Switzerland have signed a Statement of Intent on Strategic Cooperation and Dialogue on Migration, aimed at deepening bilateral engagement and expanding cooperation in migration management.

title: Trade, Energy and Regional Peace Dominate Abiy-Erdoğan Talks in Antalya
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed and Turkish President Recep Tayyip Erdoğan held bilateral talks in Antalya on 10 November on the sidelines of the COP31 UN Climate Change Conference, discussing ways to strengthen bilateral relations, particularly in trade and investment, alongside regional peace and issues of mutual interest.

title: Ethiopia, UK Discuss Climate Cooperation and COP32 Preparations
summary: [Horn Diplomat] Antalya, Türkiye -- Ethiopia and Britain discussed strengthening climate cooperation and preparations for next year's COP32 summit in Addis Ababa during talks on Thursday, Ethiopia's foreign ministry said.

title: Ethiopia's Green Energy Can Consolidate Competitive Edge in Textile, Garment Markets - German Deputy Ambassador
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Ethiopia's renewable energy resources could strengthen the competitiveness of its textile, garment, and leather products in European markets as international buyers increasingly consider sustainability alongside production standards, Germany's Deputy Ambassador in Ethiopia, Ferdinand von Weyhe said.

title: Forum Vows to Advocate Ethiopia's Strategic Interests in Nile, Red Sea
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- The newly established Nile and Red Sea Strategic Forum pledged to strengthen research, policy advocacy, and public engagement to advance Ethiopia's strategic interests in the two vital waterways.

title: Ethiopia Steps Up Regional, Global Partnerships Ahead of COP32
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Ethiopia is stepping up diplomatic engagement with regional and international partners to strengthen climate cooperation and advance shared priorities ahead of hosting the 32nd United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP32) in 2027.

title: Algerian Delegates Hail Ethiopia's Dev't Model, Call for Stronger Pan-African Political Cooperation
summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Algeria's participation in the Second African Political Parties Summit 2026 has provided opportunity for the National Building Movement party to learn from Ethiopia's experience and exchange knowledge with political leaders and government officials, the Algerian party member Jarrallah Abdelmonem said.

title: News - Drought, Conflict Threaten Emergency-Level Food Insecurity in Tigray, Amhara, Afar
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Severe drought and escalating conflict are expected to push parts of Tigray, Amhara and Afar into Emergency (IPC Phase 4) levels of food insecurity in early 2027, as widespread crop losses, disrupted markets and declining household purchasing power threaten to deepen an already deteriorating humanitarian situation, according to the Famine Early Warning Systems Network (FEWS NET).

title: More Than 64, 000 Ethiopian Refugees, Asylum-Seekers Remain in War-Hit Sudan, UN Data Shows
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- A total of 64,902 Ethiopian refugees and asylum-seekers were living in Sudan as of 31 October 2026, with more than two-thirds concentrated in Gedaref State, according to the latest figures released by the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR).

title: News - 'People Are Getting Desperate': Jimma Protests Expose Growing Anger Over Forced Conscription, Extortion
summary: [Addis Standard] Addis Abeba -- Residents of Jimma city in southwestern Oromia zone in Ethiopia say protests that erupted on Monday and Tuesday were driven by mounting grievances over widespread forced conscription, arbitrary arrests, extortion and displacement, describing an increasingly desperate population with few avenues to seek redress from authorities.
